📱 Install karanna vidhiya (Sinhala)

  1. APK eka phone ekata download karanna — Download APK button eka click karanna
  2. Phone eke Settings → Apps → Special access → Install unknown apps → File Manager / Chrome enable karanna
  3. Download folder eke AI-Binance-Trader-v1.0.0-debug.apk tap karanna → Install
  4. App open karanna → Settings tab → Login/Register (backend `http://10.0.2.2:8000` for emulator)
  5. Binance Testnet API Key/Secret dala Save & Encrypt → Test Connection → Balance balanna
  6. Dashboard eke Paper Trading walin trading start karanna — real money nathuwa safe!

Tip: Real phone ekata backend deploy karala API_BASE_URL phone eke LAN IP ekata change karanna (docs/SETUP.md balanna)

🛠️ Signed Release APK build karanna

GitHub Actions (automatic):

git tag v1.0.0 && git push origin v1.0.0 → GitHub → Actions → Artifacts download app-release.apk

Local (Android Studio):

cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
Keystore config in gradle.properties (never commit)

cd backend && cp .env.example .env && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
